market_price_context.summary: Listing-site snippets for Chennai Bollywood dance classes suggest that fees vary by class duration, trainer experience, batch size, studio facilities, and course level; some listings describe prices as reasonable rather than publishing a fixed fee.

UrbanPro search results for Chennai Bollywood dance classes show a user budget band of Rs. 3,000 to Rs. 6,000 per month for adult training requests, which is market context rather than a single studio's price.
UrbanPro search results also show a broader monthly budget band of Rs. 1,000 to Rs. 3,000 for some adult Bollywood dance-class enquiries in Chennai.
